description: Fix the create-issue success toast so it renders the new issue's number (e.g. `Issue #223 created`) instead of `undefined`, and add a number-free error toast on failed creates.

tasks.title: Fix create-issue toast to show correct issue number
tasks.description: In `packages/web/src/features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.tsx`, change the `useMutation` `onSuccess` handler to capture the API response as `data: Issue` and emit `toast.success(\`Issue #${data.number} created\`)` reading `number` from the bare `Issue` response (not a `{ issue }` wrapper). Add an `onError: (err) => toast.error(err.message || 'Failed to create issue')` handler so failed creates surface a number-free error toast. Keep the existing `queryClient.invalidateQueries` and `resetAndClose()` calls. Extend `CreateIssueDialog.test.tsx` (hoisting a `toast` mock via `vi.hoisted`, reset in `afterEach`) to assert the success toast renders the literal `Issue #<n> created` against a mocked bare `Issue` response with a concrete number, and to assert the error path emits an error toast with no issue number.
acceptanceCriteria: On a successful create where the API returns an `Issue` with `number: 223`, the UI shows a `sonner` success toast containing the literal text `Issue #223 created`.
The success toast never renders `undefined` or any placeholder in place of the number.
The `onSuccess` handler reads the number from the bare create response's `Issue.number` field, not from a `{ issue }` wrapper path.
A failed create surfaces a `sonner` error toast that does not reference any issue number (and never renders `undefined`).
`CreateIssueDialog.test.tsx` asserts the success toast text against a mocked bare `Issue` response with a concrete number.
`CreateIssueDialog.test.tsx` asserts the failed-create path emits an error toast with no issue number.
tasks.output: Updated `packages/web/src/features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.tsx` with corrected `onSuccess`/`onError` toast handling, and extended `packages/web/src/features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.test.tsx` covering both the success-number and error-toast scenarios.
tasks.notes: Web-only change; no API contract change. `createIssue` (`entities/issue/api/client.ts`) already returns a bare `Issue` with `number`; do not refactor it to a wrapper (explicit non-goal). Follow the established `toast.success(...)` / `toast.error(...)` `sonner` pattern used in `entities/epic/api/queries.ts`. Use the `vi.hoisted` toast mock pattern from `SettingsSearch.test.tsx` / `EpicListPage.test.tsx`.
